content:
Aisha K.: Quick poll — pub quiz + pizza next Fri (7:00pm) at The Rusty Anchor? Who's in? :pizza: :beer:
Connor: Love it. count me in :raised_hands:
Priya: I'm out that night, but would join next week. any veg/vegan options for pizza? :herb:
Diego: I can make 7pm. Trivia team name ideas: 'KV Cache Kings' or 'Batch Overlords' :laughing:
Riley: Both great. Or 'Inference & Tonic' :tropical_drink:  
Maya: Prefer a board-game night instead? easier to actually talk. anyone want to bring Catan/other games? :game_die:
Aisha K.: Either works. pub quiz = low effort, game night = social points. Who can bring games? :sweat_smile:
Connor: I can bring Catan + Ticket to Ride.
Priya: If it's pizza please keep at least one GF option.
Diego: I'll check Rusty Anchor menu for GF + vegan slices and report back.
Riley: Time tweak — can we do 7pm instead of 6:30? earlier clashes with my sitter.
Aisha K.: 7pm works for me. Let's lock 7pm. Final RSVP by Wed noon?
Maya: Fine with 7. If people want games later we can run a separate game night next month.
Connor: :thumbsup: RSVP emoji plan: :thumbsup: = in, :wave: = maybe, :x: = out
Priya: :wave: (sad) — out this Fri
Diego: :thumbsup:
Riley: :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll bring Sushi Go and Codenames in case we go games instead.
Aisha K.: Thanks! Diego please confirm the GF/vegan options and I'll create the calendar invite. :calendar:
calendar-bot: Event created: "Team Friday — Pub Quiz / Game Night" on Fri Apr 12 19:00. Guests invited: Aisha K., Connor, Diego, Riley, Maya. Location: The Rusty Anchor — https://therustyanchor.example/events/4242
Connor: Also, is the team social budget still available to cover apps/drinks?
Diego: Checked with finance earlier — we have leftover social stipend for this month, should be fine to cover a round or two.
Riley: Perfect. See you all Friday! :party_parrot:
Aisha K.: Awesome — will ping a reminder on Thu and post final headcount. Thanks all!"
